content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source defining MODULE BATHY_CORRECTION_MODULE (L65-253; header L57-62: corrects bathy/topo data where slope exceeds a threshold such as slope>1.0 default; Shi 04/24/2017). Module data (SAVE): allocatable Depth0, Depth1, Gradx0, Grady0, Gradx, Grady, Depth_org (L74-75), MASK0 (L76), scalars SmoothBelowDepth, SlopeCap (L77), myvar, myint (L79-80). SUBROUTINE CORRECTION (L84-226, called from INITIALIZATION when BATHY_CORRECTION=T): sets pointcount=0, threshold=0.05_SP (L99-100); reads SmoothBelowDepth (default -LARGE, i.e. smooth everywhere, L106-109) and SlopeCap (default 1.0_SP, L111-114) from the input file via READ_FLOAT; logs both (L116-123); allocates work arrays (L126-129); builds MASK0: cells (and their 4 neighbors) with Depth0<SmoothBelowDepth are excluded (MASK0=0) over Jbeg-1..Jend+1/Ibeg-1..Iend+1 (L131-147), exchanged via phi_int_exch (L149); computes initial slope magnitudes Gradx0=|Depth0(I+1,J)-Depth0(I-1,J)|/DX, Grady0 likewise (L154-162, note the centered difference over 2 cells is divided by DX not 2DX); iterative smoothing loop DO WHILE(change_percentage>threshold .AND. pointcount<=1000) (L166): recomputes Gradx/Grady (L179-180), and where MAX(Gradx,Grady)>SlopeCap applies the 5-point smoothing stencil Depth1=0.4*Depth0+0.15*(4 neighbors) (L183-184), tracks the relative change tmp1=|Depth0-Depth1|/MAX(MinDepthFrc*10,Depth0) as change_percentage (L185-186); each iteration exchanges Depth1 (phi_exch, L194), copies Depth0=Depth1 (L196), increments PointCount (L198), and MPI_ALLREDUCE-MAXes change_percentage across ranks (L200-201). After convergence: logs total iteration count (L209-213), Depth=Depth0 (L216), exchanges Depth and all gradient arrays (L218-222), and CALL OUTPUT_CORRECTION (L224). SUBROUTINE OUTPUT_CORRECTION (L228-251): writes diagnostic fields to RESULT_FOLDER via PutFile: depth_org.txt (Depth_org), depth_change.txt (Depth_org-Depth0), gradx0.txt, grady0.txt, gradx.txt, grady.txt (L238-249).
entities: MODULE BATHY_CORRECTION_MODULE @L65 (END @L253); USE PARAM @L66; USE GLOBAL,ONLY:Mloc,Nloc,Nghost,Ibeg,Iend,Jbeg,Jend,DX,DY,Depth,INPUT_FILE_NAME @L67; USE INPUT_READ @L68; USE GLOBAL,ONLY:myid,ier,npx,npy,PX,PY @L69; USE MPI @L70; SAVE @L72
module arrays Depth0,Depth1,Gradx0,Grady0,Gradx,Grady,Depth_org @L74-75; MASK0 @L76; SmoothBelowDepth,SlopeCap @L77; myvar @L79; myint @L80

SUBROUTINE CORRECTION @L84 (END @L226); USE GLOBAL,ONLY:itmp1..itmp4,SMALL,LARGE,tmp1,tmp2,tmp3,MinDepthFrc @L85-86; locals FILE_NAME @L90, TMP_NAME @L91, Ifile,ierr,K,K5,K10,K15,pointcount @L92, change_percentage,threshold @L93, status(MPI_STATUS_SIZE,4) @L95, req(4) @L96, nreq,len @L97
SUBROUTINE OUTPUT_CORRECTION @L228 (END @L251); USE GLOBAL,ONLY:RESULT_FOLDER @L229; locals TMP_NAME @L233, FDIR @L234

io.name: log 'Bathymetry correction ...', SmoothBelowDepth, SlopeCap to units 3 and * (rank 0)
OUTPUT_CORRECTION PutFile: depth_org.txt @L239, depth_change.txt @L241, gradx0.txt @L243, grady0.txt @L245, gradx.txt @L247, grady.txt @L249

unresolved: Gradx0/Gradx use a centered difference over 2*DX but divide only by DX (L158,L179) — the 'slope' compared against SlopeCap is twice the actual centered-difference slope, or a one-sided-scaled definition; not clarified in file
the smoothing stencil coefficients 0.4+4*0.15=1.0 conserve the sum only on uniform fields; Depth1 at masked/boundary-adjacent cells uses Depth0 neighbors that may be outside the corrected set

change_percentage is written into tmp1, a GLOBAL temporary (L185) — thread-unsafe reuse; locals Ifile,K,K5,K10,K15,nreq,len,req,status,myint,TMP_NAME(in CORRECTION) are declared but unused (the MPI_WAITALL usage is commented out @L206)

SmoothBelowDepth semantics: MASK0=0 (excluded from correction) where Depth0<SmoothBelowDepth — with the -LARGE default nothing is excluded; the name suggests smoothing BELOW a depth but the code excludes below it; intent ambiguity noted
iteration cap 1000 and threshold 0.05 are hard-coded; convergence is on max relative change, reduced across ranks each iteration; phi_exch/phi_int_exch/PutFile are cross-file
